Migration.Purpose: Durable engineering and execution rules carried from the legacy GRACE documentation into the mandatory GRACE 4 principles context.

GracePrinciples.ContractFirst: Every governed module is preceded by a MODULE_CONTRACT with PURPOSE, SCOPE, DEPENDS, LINKS, ROLE, and MAP_MODE; implementation follows the contract.
GracePrinciples.SemanticMarkup: START_MODULE_CONTRACT, START_MODULE_MAP, START_CONTRACT, START_BLOCK, and START_CHANGE_SUMMARY markers are navigation and verification anchors. Anchors stay unique, paired, and small enough for deterministic navigation.
GracePrinciples.TopDownSynthesis: RequirementsAnalysis, TechnologyStack, DevelopmentPlan, VerificationPlan, then code and tests define the allowed change space.
GracePrinciples.GraphCurrent: Any module, export, dependency, data-flow, or verification change updates the corresponding GRACE 4 graph and verification projection.
GracePrinciples.VerificationFirst: Deterministic unit assertions precede integration and head-unit smoke checks; critical event ordering is protected by trace or log assertions.
GracePrinciples.GovernedAutonomy: Execution packets must declare write scope, assumptions, graph delta, verification delta, evidence, checkpoint fields, and stop conditions. No retroactive C-* bundles are created during migration.
GracePrinciples.IsolationInvariant: Any setupServiceLocator change updates both the UI bootstrap and background onStart bootstrap because isolates do not share registrations.
GracePrinciples.VehicleBoundaryInvariant: AndroidAutomotivePlugin is instantiated only by HvacService; other consumers resolve HvacService from the locator.
GracePrinciples.StablePersistenceContract: SharedPreferences keys and HeatMode/UserType enum names are migration-sensitive public contracts and cannot be renamed without an explicit migration.
GracePrinciples.DebugSafety: Debug affordances must clear injected values and in-memory logs when disabled so diagnostics cannot affect real vehicle behavior.
GracePrinciples.ReleaseDiscipline: Release tags are v*; version and CHANGELOG entries precede tagging, and the release workflow builds the arm64 APK and publishes the changelog section.
GracePrinciples.FailureHandoff: When validation or cleanup fails, preserve legacy artifacts and report the exact failure and first divergent block; do not retry destructive cleanup automatically.
